literal_meaning: সকল দেবতাময় অতিথি (guest embodying all deities)
figurative_meaning_bn: অতিথি দেবতার বা গুরুর মতই পূজনীয়
figurative_meaning_en: The guest is as worship-worthy as a god or guru
similar_in_english: Entertain strangers as you might entertain angels
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাদের সংস্কৃতিতে অতিথিকে সর্বদেবময় অতিথি বলে সম্মান করা হয়।
বাড়িতে কেউ এলে সর্বদেবময় অতিথি হিসেবে তাদের সেবা করো।
example_sentences_in_english: In our culture, guests are honored as 'sarvadevamaya atithi'.
Treat every visitor at home as 'sarvadevamaya atithi' with utmost respect.
history: Derived from the ancient Sanskrit concept 'Atithi Devo Bhava' (Guest is God) found in the Taittiriya Upanishad, emphasizing hospitality as a sacred duty in Hindu tradition.
note: This idiom reflects the deep-rooted Bengali value of treating guests with divine reverence, influenced by broader Indian scriptural traditions.
